task.description: Create a comprehensive architectural visualization of the opentoonz-eva codebase. Every diagram must stay inside the declared diagram complexity budget: small, single-concern diagrams split across per-subsystem documents rather than one large diagram per cluster. Exclude the toonz/build folder. Each subsystem cluster should be analyzed by a separate agent working in parallel where possible.

Perform an initial scan of the repository structure to identify all subsystems, their boundaries, and inter-module dependency patterns from CMakeLists.txt and include directives. Also establish the diagram conventions every later phase must obey, so diagram size and splitting rules are decided once and referenced, not re-invented per cluster.

phase.review: Changes requested by xml-autonomous-approver. Evidence: read all 4 declared output files; spot-checked ~20 class/node names appearing in their Mermaid diagrams and "Key Classes"/References sections against grep results over toonz/sources/include and toonz/sources/common (the real source tree; tnzcore/ and tnzbase/ themselves are mostly empty CMakeLists.txt shells that pull sources from common/, which the docs correctly note in one place but then contradict elsewhere). Findings: - [BLOCKER] opentoonz__core_tnzcore_architecture.md, Diagram 3 ("Platform Primitives & I/O"): nodes TSound, TSoundIO, TIPC, and TColorStyles do not exist anywhere in the codebase (zero grep matches in toonz/sources/include or toonz/sources/common). Real equivalents: audio type is TSoundTrack/TSoundTrackFormat (include/tsound.h); the IPC class is `Server`/`SocketController` in include/tipcsrv.h and tipcsrvP.h, not a class named TIPC (TIPC only appears as a header-guard prefix in tipcmsg.h). TColorStyles has no match at all. That is 4 of 14 nodes (~29%) in this diagram fabricated. - [BLOCKER] opentoonz__core_tnzbase_tnzext_architecture.md, "References & Implementation Details": the listed source paths (toonz/sources/tnzbase/tparam.cpp, tfx.cpp, texpression.cpp, tpluginmanager.cpp) do not exist. toonz/sources/tnzbase/ contains only permissionsmanager.cpp, stringtable.cpp, texternfx.cpp, tfxattributes.cpp, tfxutil.cpp, trasterfx.cpp, and tscanner/ — the actual files live in toonz/sources/common/tparam/, common/tfx/tfx.cpp, common/expressions/texpression.cpp, and common/tsystem/tpluginmanager.cpp. A reader following these references as written would hit missing files. - [MAJOR] Same document, Diagram 8 (tlin linear algebra): nodes tlin::Vector, tlin::Matrix, tlin::SparseMatrix are cased as PascalCase types, but the real classes in include/tlin/tlin_{vector,matrix,sparsemat}.h are lowercase: tlin::vector, tlin::matrix, tlin::sparse_matrix. - [BLOCKER] opentoonz__core_common_architecture.md, Theme 3 diagram ("I/O and Streams"): "Key Classes" and diagram nodes TImageIo, TIpc, TIpcSocket, TSoundFile, and TWainDevice all return zero grep matches anywhere in toonz/sources. The scanner module is actually C-style TWAIN bindings (common/twain/ttwain*.{c,h}) wrapped by TScannerTwain (tnzbase/tscanner/tscannertwain.h), not a class called TWainDevice. This is a systemic pattern (9+ fabricated identifiers across all 3 detail documents), not an isolated typo, and it lands squarely on this phase's stated review focus: "accuracy of class hierarchies... correctness of dependency arrows." The p1-step-7 verify step checked Mermaid syntax, budget compliance, and link resolution, but there is no evidence it cross-checked node/class names against actual source symbols — which is how these fabrications survived.
